title: Hayati Pro Max Fizzy Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Fizzy Cherry delivers a bright burst of juicy Cherry with a sparkling, sherbet-like character. The Cherry flavour is bold and sweet, lifted by an effervescent edge that gives the vape a light, tongue-tingling profile—reminiscent of cherry-flavoured fizzy sweets. Blended with nicotine salts for quicker satisfaction and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG formulation ensures reliable vapour production and full-flavour delivery. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
